_read_me: Template. Copy this to mcp_secrets.json in the same folder and put real values in that copy.
This example file is safe to commit and contains no real credentials.
mcp_secrets.json is listed in .gitignore and is a SEALED path - her tools cannot write it,
and neither can a proposed patch. This example is sealed too, for the same reason in reverse:
it IS committed, so a credential pasted into it here would land in git history.
Keys are SERVER IDS, and they must match the ids in mcp.json. Each server is handed ONLY
the block that belongs to it, so an image server never receives the Spotify token.
Values are read once at boot by mcp_client. Rotating a value needs a restart, not a patch.
Nothing here is ever printed: logs name the variable, never the value.
